transcript: Agent: Good morning. Is this Mrs. Priya Sharma speaking? Agent calling from Axis Finance regarding your outstanding loan amount for account number BLN45789012X. Your payment of eighteen thousand seven hundred and fifty rupees was due on the seventh of this month, actually. Customer: Ah, good morning. Yes, this is Priya only. But I'm a little bit... confused. Why are you calling, no? This loan, I think... this loan was actually already closed, you know. Yeah, closed. I settled it fully, maybe four, five months back already. Agent: Ma'am, as per our system, the loan account BLN45789012X is currently showing as active only, and with an outstanding balance. The EMI for this month, as I mentioned, is also overdue. Are you sure? Could you perhaps, uh, check your records from your side? Maybe there is some misunderstanding, ma'am? Customer: No, no, no misunderstanding at all! How can it be? I clearly remember clearing the entire amount. It was a full and final settlement. I even got, you know, a No Objection Certificate, an NOC, from your company only, through email after that. I have it saved! It was for this specific loan, I definitely remember the account number also mentioned there. That's why I'm surprised by your call. <interruption> And I've been getting, you know, too many repeated calls for this same thing for the last few days, and it's quite frustrating when I know it's settled. Agent: An NOC, you say? That is unusual, ma'am. If you received an NOC, then our system, it should definitely reflect the closure, right? It's really very unusual for an NOC to be issued if the account is still open in our records. Can you please, uh, just share that NOC copy with us? If you can forward it to our official email ID, collections@axisbank.in, along with your registered mobile number, then we can surely escalate this for a verification with our finance and legal team. This could, perhaps, be an error from our end, if what you say is correct. Customer: Of course I can forward it. But this is very inconvenient for me. My credit score, no, I am sure it must have been affected already if you are reporting this as an active loan to the bureau. You need to correct it on the bureau side immediately. And stop calling me for this 'outstanding' amount. Okay? I will send you the email right away now. Please just confirm receipt once you get it and make sure this is sorted out, fully permanently. Agent: Absolutely, ma'am. Please send us the NOC copy as soon as possible. Once we receive it, we will immediately confirm the receipt and escalate the matter for review. If it is confirmed that the loan was indeed closed, then we will initiate all necessary corrections on our end, including updating your credit bureau records. And regarding the calls, once this issue is under review, the calls will certainly be put on hold for this account. Thank you for informing us about this. Customer: Thank you. I will send it now only.

Agent: "Good morning, my name is Priya from XYZ Collections, am I speaking with Mr. Rajesh Kumar?"

Agent: "Mr. Kumar, I understand your frustration. I am calling regarding your personal loan account, number ending in 8765. An EMI of twelve thousand five hundred rupees for the 7th of April is currently outstanding."
Customer: "Outstanding or not, that's not the point here. I have informed your company, repeatedly. My legal representative has already sent a formal cease and desist notice regarding these calls. You received it weeks ago! I even have the tracking details for the registered post. This constant harassment has to stop."
Agent: "I see, Mr. Kumar. You are stating that a formal DNC request was issued by your lawyer. I sincerely apologise for the calls still coming through. Can you please confirm the name of your legal representative or a reference from that communication, so I can ensure our records are updated immediately and action taken?"
Customer: "The lawyer is Mr. Anand Singh. His office number is on the letter you received. I am not providing further details to every new agent who calls me. Just find the letter, confirm it. And make sure these calls stop. Permanently. Any further calls will be considered a breach and will be escalated directly to the consumer court. I am making it very clear."
Agent: "Understood, Mr. Kumar. I have noted down the name Mr. Anand Singh and the cease and desist instruction. I will ensure your account is immediately flagged with a Do Not Contact instruction and escalated for verification with our legal team. All collection outreach from our side will stop pending this review. Thank you for informing us again."
Customer: "Just ensure it happens this time. Thank you."

transcript: Agent: Good afternoon, Mr. Anil Sharma. My name is Rajesh from LoanServe Financials. I am calling regarding your overdue personal loan account number ending 90. transcript: Agent: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mr. Rahul Sharma?My name is Aarti and I'm calling from CreditConnect. We're trying to reach you regarding your personal loan account, number 4001XXXX56. Your outstanding amount is INR 55,000, which has been overdue for 30 days now.Customer: Hello? Who is this? I don't know any Rahul Sharma and I definitely don't have any loan with CreditConnect. You must have the wrong number.Agent: Sir, is this not Mr. Rahul Sharma? Our records show this number, 987XXXXXXX, is registered to Mr. Rahul Sharma, son of Mr. Prakash Sharma, residing at Gali Number 3, Karol Bagh, Delhi. Can you please confirm your date of birth for verification, sir?Customer: What rubbish are you talking about? My name is Ajay Kumar, and my father's name is Suresh Kumar. I live in Vasant Kunj, not Karol Bagh. This is completely wrong! I haven't taken any loan from anyone, especially not for 55,000 rupees. I don't know who this Rahul Sharma is, but it's not me.Agent: Sir, I understand your concern. However, as per our records linked to your PAN card and Aadhaar card, this loan was disbursed under the name Rahul Sharma. Could there be any error from your end? Did you perhaps use these documents for someone else, or lose them recently?Customer: Are you crazy? Lose my PAN and Aadhaar? No way! This sounds like some kind of fraud to me. Someone must have used my identity without my knowledge. I never applied for this loan. You people are calling the wrong person and saying I owe money! This is a serious issue. I want to know how this loan was even taken in the first place, and I want proof!Agent: Sir, please remain calm. I understand this is distressing. If you believe your identity has been compromised, we can certainly investigate this as a potential fraud case. I will escalate this internally to our fraud investigation team immediately. They will require some documentation from your side to proceed. Would you be able to provide an FIR copy or any other identity proof to confirm your claim, sir?Customer: FIR? For a loan I never took? This is all so messed up! First you tell me I have a loan, then you ask for FIR. I'll need to understand what documents you even used for this loan. I am not taking responsibility for this 'Rahul Sharma's' loan. Please stop calling me, this number belongs to Ajay Kumar, and I want my name removed from your system for this fake loan.Agent: Sir, as I said, we will open a fraud investigation. I'm noting down your request to flag this account as an 'Identity Theft' case. Our team will contact you regarding the documents required to proceed with the investigation. Please ensure you cooperate with them to resolve this. For now, I will mark this interaction under a dispute due to potential identity theft, and all collections calls will be put on hold for this specific loan from our end. We will update you with the next steps from our fraud team, sir. Is there any other contact number we can reach you on, just in case?Customer: No, use this one. Just make sure no one else calls me asking for Rahul Sharma. This is Ajay Kumar, clear? And this loan is not mine. This is fraudulent.Agent: Understood, Mr. Ajay Kumar. We will proceed accordingly and escalate your concerns. You will hear from our dedicated fraud investigation team shortly.
L3: Denies Taking the Loan|Identity Theft – Loan Not Authorised|Fraud Signal – Identity Inconsistency on Call

transcript: Agent: Good morning, my name is Rajat from Swift Finance. Am I speaking with Mrs. Shanti Devi? Customer: Yes, you are. And let me tell you, I am absolutely fed up with your calls! Every day, three, four times! Even at 8 AM in the morning and late evenings! What kind of service is this? Agent: Ma'am, I understand your concern. This call is regarding your personal loan account number 8976XXXX5432, where your EMIs of Rupees 15,000 for February and March are still outstanding. We are trying to reach you regarding the overdue payment. Customer: Outstanding? I know it's outstanding! Do you think I've forgotten? But this constant harassment is unacceptable! Your agents keep calling and some of them speak so rudely. One fellow even told me my CIBIL score would be ruined if I don't pay 'right now'. Is that how you treat customers? This is mental harassment! Agent: Ma'am, I assure you we do not condone rude behaviour. We record all calls for quality purposes. Can you please confirm which agent spoke to you rudely or share the exact time of the call so I can investigate? Customer: Exact time? How do I remember all that when I'm getting calls non-stop from different numbers? Just yesterday evening, after 8 PM, I received a call. This is going too far. If this continues, I will have no option but to report you to the RBI and complain on social media as well. I understand I have an outstanding, but this method is wrong. Agent: Ma'am, please let me clarify the situation with your account. We can try to work out a solution for the payment. However, I must note your feedback regarding the call frequency and agent conduct. I will certainly log this complaint for you and ensure it's escalated to our compliance department immediately. We apologize for any inconvenience or distress caused. Customer: It's not just inconvenience, it's harassment. Just ensure it stops. I need some time to arrange funds, I will try to pay by the 15th of April. But first, resolve this calling issue. Agent: Understood, Mrs. Devi. I have noted down your complaint in detail. We will ensure the necessary action is taken regarding the call frequency and agent behaviour. Regarding your payment, what date can we expect the overdue amount? Customer: I said, I will try to pay by the 15th of April. But first, resolve this calling issue.
